AS $function$ BEGIN IF (((((((SELECT "subject_row"."id" FROM "security_raw"."employee" AS "subject_row" WHERE "subject_row"."native_login" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) SESSION_USER::pg_catalog.text) OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) E'Alice'::pg_catalog.text))) IS TRUE))) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original query use unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; IF ((SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a WHERE a.attrelid OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) pg_catalog.to_regclass(E'"security_raw"."original_salary_source"'::pg_catalog.text) AND a.attnum OPERATOR(pg_catalog.>) 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND ((a.attname::pg_catalog.text OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) E'id'::pg_catalog.text AND a.atttypid OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) E'pg_catalog.text'::pg_catalog.text::pg_catalog.regtype) OR (a.attname::pg_catalog.text OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) E'salary'::pg_catalog.text AND a.atttypid OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) E'pg_catalog.int8'::pg_catalog.text::pg_catalog.regtype))) OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 2::pg_catalog.int8) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original carrier unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; IF ((NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "security_raw"."resource" AS "collection_root" WHERE (TRUE) AND ((SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM "security_raw"."original_salary_source" AS "original_row" WHERE (TRUE) AND "original_row"."id" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) "collection_root"."id") OPERATOR(pg_catalog.<>) 1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "security_raw"."original_salary_source" AS "original_row" WHERE (TRUE) AND "original_row"."id" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) "collection_root"."id" AND ("original_row"."id" IS NULL OR "original_row"."salary" IS NULL))))) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "security_raw"."original_salary_source" AS "original_row" WHERE (TRUE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "security_raw"."resource" AS "collection_root" WHERE (TRUE) AND "original_row"."id" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) "collection_root"."id")))) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501';
